newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates rise in short market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates rise in short market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound were up on Sunday in a short market to between 8-3/4 and 9-3/8 percent from 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent on Wednesday, bankers said.
"There's demand for Egyptian pounds because banks are balancing out at the start of the week," one banker said. Banks were closed on Thursday for a public holiday.
One-week rates were also slightly higher at between 8-7/8 and 9-1/8 percent compared to 7-7/8 and 8-3/8 percent, they added.
